'''Cho nor hoola''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] stew made of sour [[Milk/Legends|milk]], powdered [[Bone/Legends|bones]], and [[Protato/Legends|protatoes]]. It smelled quite vile, so it took a strong willpower to eat a full serving without feeling ill. Some ingredients acted as antitoxins.

The Hutt crimelord [[Rokko]] enjoyed cho nor hoola.
